decisions.decision: The Commission will write a letter to the plumbing inspector for clarification on the external tank (grease trap).
decisions.quote: the commission will write a letter to the plumbing inspector for clarification on the external tank.

decisions.decision: Twin City Baptist is expected to be compliant in the meantime while the non-compliance fees are on hold.
decisions.quote: twin city is expected to be compliant in the meantime.

decisions.decision: The Commission emphasized it would prefer one betterment for Pratt Street and does not recommend two.
decisions.quote: the commission emphasized that they would prefer one betterment and do not recommend two.

decisions.decision: Dario's Pizza was told the grease trap needs to be cleaned monthly and to show weekly inspections.

decisions.decision: No change to the sewer extension schedule; Lakeview stays after Pratt (no motion to change order).
